# S56 — Say a record exists on another branch instead of plain not found

When a slice worktree's docs cite an adj record that exists only on the base branch, `adj show ID` and `adj lint` say the record exists on another branch (naming it) instead of a plain "record not found", so the agent knows to merge the base branch rather than doubt the citation.

**Findings:** 2026-11-18, ork run ork-20261118-120855-7418 (ork slice S405, gate role, tool feedback): in the S405 worktree, `adj show 462` printed `record not found: id 462` while the worktree's docs and the UI pass cited adj 462 as decided. Record 462 had been decided on the base branch (main) after the worktree branched, so the worktree's store did not have it yet. Filed from ork S430 (retired there: adj changes belong in this repo). · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Owners decide records on the base branch while slice worktrees run; agents in those worktrees then see "not found" for records that are real and decided, and may report a false finding or stop. Seen in ork on 2026-11-18 (ork S405, adj 462).

Open points for the spec: how adj learns the base branch (git, config, or a flag); whether `adj lint` warns or stays quiet; whether this reads git objects (adj is standard library only).
